g.text: RTP Status Update Flow (async callback) — POST /status-update
Callback sent by the Payer's SRTP-SP when the sync
find Rtp by resourceId (original message id)
State unchanged, nothing written to the DB
[ALREADY APPLIED] RTP already in the state implied by the reason
idempotent no-op, nothing written to the DB
- Reason AEXR / ARFR / ARJR (Final states saved to ADX & deleted from MONGO)
[400 Bad Request] Callback Content Error Cases
- Invalid status transition from current state
- MongoDB update / delete failed after retries
[RTP NOT FOUND] RTP not in DB
Unknown resourceId, or RTP already finalized & deleted
[SP NOT FOUND] Debtor SP not in registry
[INVALID REQUEST] Empty body / missing Debtor SP id / missing original message id
